title: SafeSteer: Localized On-Policy Distillation for Efficient Safety Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model refusal behavior on safety benchmarks such as PKU-SafeRLHF and ALERT, which include categories for 'biased remarks' and discriminatory content.

Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) across multiple safety benchmarks (AdvBench, HarmBench, JailbreakBench, SORRY-Bench) that involve adversarial prompts, criminal advice, and other unsafe behaviors.
